notes.title: Loading a level
notes.content:
During the start of the game scene, small game brakes were visible. This was due to loading the level. This problem was especially visible on mobile devices.
But now, this problem (masked) has been fixed on all platforms.

notes.title: Fixed two items
notes.content: Two items with food (meat and bad meat) were corrected in the game. It did not update the amount of health when consumed. Now everything is working.

notes.title: Bug when saving at low HP
notes.content: Fixed a bug that occurred when saving a game with a low HP. for Example, when a player is starving and has a low HP, he presses save. Then he dies and continues the game. After that, the game was buggy.

notes.title: Optimization!
notes.content:
In the game, a lot of work was done to optimize the load on RAM. Now the game consumes 80 percent less RAM! This optimization also makes it easier for the video card and CPU to work.
Thanks to these changes, the mobile version of the game will get a full-size generation of the game world with a length of 30 locations (previously there were 15 locations for the mobile version). If anyone is interested in the android version of the game, you can download it for FREE here
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.HeX.ThirtyDaystosurvive

notes.title: Access to the Google Play platform!
notes.content:
Hello everyone You can already register in Google Play on the game page, and then you will be the first to know when this game will be fully available on Google Play.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.HeX.ThirtyDaystosurvive

The mobile version of the game differs from this one only in the length of the game world. Instead of 30 locations that are generated during the game, 15 will be available. But in total, they will all be randomly generated as it is now in the windows version.
I'll be glad to see you all!

notes.title: Fixed a critical error
notes.content: A bug was fixed in the game that broke the mechanism of the entire game. It happened when the player picked up some of the weapons. Now there should be no problems with this!

notes.title: New achievements! The completion of the game.
notes.content:
Two new achievements have been added to the game, for which you can get rewards:
1. Live 30 days;
2. Repair the boat.
Also, in addition, the game found a place from which the player could pass through the wall and "fall under the location". Now this flaw has been corrected.

notes.title: Fixed bugs. Added a hotkey. Optimized the game.
notes.content:
1. Inventory errors were fixed in the game (there were problems with guns, when they were moved from quick access to the satchel - cartridges were added), this error appeared after the last update.
2. Now the game has a hot key for opening and closing of the container. To do this, press the "TAB"key.
3. The game was further optimized by removing duplicate materials. This optimization reduces the load on the video core.

notes.title: You have the opportunity to help find errors!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32200705/eb24cefd486053676edc43859579a8d49b3408ec.jpg[/img]
The game has added the ability to view the developer console. Now in case of an error (red exclamation mark), you can understand that a critical error occurred in the game. To activate the console, you need to go to settings in the main menu and click "Console". During red errors, click on it and copy it, or take a screenshot and send it to the community.
I will be very grateful to anyone who can help us detect such bugs in the game!

Other updates in the game:
1. Skins for wood and metal armor have been updated;
2. The system for selecting new weapons was slightly changed.

Note:
The game will soon be ported to the mobile platform.

notes.title: Added character skins to the game. Fixed inventory bug.
More loyal generation of the world! New algorithm for saving gameplay!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32200705/e47e6fe12a44d3a18e8d6f5bfdb2f5ce2f06a158.jpg[/img]

1. The game will now have a more loyal generation of the game world. Now it will be easier to start a new game! On the first location will not spawn animals, and rare mobs (fat man, spitting poison, etc.). Also, the first location will no longer spawn a car with an active alarm system. And now the first location will never be a "swamp".
2. New game saving system! Previously, the game process was saved automatically when the player enters the base. This could harm the player, since he does not always return to the base full, and this killed him, and as a result, the player continued the game with a "dead loop". But now, the game is saved manually. Now the player just needs to click on the virtual button (on the interface) to save, at any time they need. The main condition to make a save-the player must be on the base.

notes.title: Added a new weapon - a flamethrower. As well as other improvements!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32200705/bc7e0970966bfe8ae2031031a895df42629c48ad.gif[/img]

1. A new weapon has been added to the game - a flamethrower. It is able to massively fry up a bunch of zombies!
2. The ability to create fuel for a flamethrower was added to the crafting section (located at the workbench). This requires only one ingredient - a Molotov cocktail.
3. Was fixed a glitch in the animation of the character (was incorrectly detected transitions animations)
4. The program code of the player training section has been updated.

In the near future, we plan to make an "easy start" for the player, that is, not to generate dangerous zombies and difficult obstacles at the first location.

notes.title: In crafting added the ability to create cartridges/shells for new weapons!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32200705/693a6c9c09e3facb2c040d0a4501552ddca1bab6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32200705/e33169a9ed2dd3a45307291627f0f2287745a6dd.jpg[/img][/url]

In craft (near the workbench) added the ability to create cartridges/shells for new types of weapons
1. For the Bazooka;
2. For the sniper rifle;
3. For a revolving grenade launcher.

To create cartridges, it is enough to have at least two gunpowder in the satchel.

In addition, improvements were made to the software code for the sniper rifle and the revolver grenade launcher.

notes.title: Added a new weapon-a revolver grenade launcher
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32200705/7075136188c3680d11254afe84bf9eea5fa057f8.gif[/img]

1. The game was added one more weapon switching grenade launcher! It has an explosion radius like a normal hand grenade, and like a Bazooka. But this weapon is special in that its projectile flies in an arc!
2. Fixed bug with quick access to weapons - sniper.
3. Was changed icons parts of a boat.

notes.title: Added a new weapon. Updated the animator.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32200705/645207eca765f7c7357f4cf610e2c9c6f961240e.gif[/img]

1. The game has found problems with the Bazooka animation, and changes have been made to the animator for animations with a Bazooka.
2. A new weapon has been added to the game - a sniper! Now you can deal huge damage to zombies in the range of 100-200 health points at a long distance. Special animations for the player were added to the animator for sniping. In the future it will be possible added the laser sight to the sniper.
3. Slightly updated icons in arms.
4. Fixed small bugs with the inventory.

notes.title: Added a Bazooka weapon
notes.content:
A new weapon, the Bazooka, was added to the game. To add it to the game, I had to do a lot of work with the animation controller.
The Bazooka will easily dismember any zombie.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32200705/6a220641d81d1a7a9c0d45763c18542d2b0f0abe.gif[/img]

notes.title: Hotkey
notes.content: Keyboard shortcuts have been added to the game. Now you can quickly use items from your inventory using the keyboard keys "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6".

notes.title: Simplified display of remaining cartridges
notes.content: Previously, the player , when the inventory is open , had to determine the number of cartridges by comparing the icons of cartridges. This all created discomfort for the player. Now we have simplified this nuance, the number of cartridges is now displayed directly in the inventory cell itself.

notes.title: Improved inventory!
notes.content: In the inventory, improvements were made to the algorithm for moving objects between the satchel and quick access. Now it works more correctly. In the case when there are a lot of identical objects in the satchel, then when moving the object that was clicked will be moved, and not the one that was the first in the inventory list.

notes.title: Transparency in the foreground of the camera!
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] In the "Farm" and "Cemetery" locations in the foreground of the camera view, transparency of objects was implemented.
[*] Ladders were added to the "prison" and "Tunnel" locations so that the player can return to the opposite direction!
[*] When a player was killed and wanted to make a quick restart-the ability to load a saved game was removed, and a new game starts when you click the "Restart" button. Now you need to fully die(watch the video of the player's death), and it will load through the main menu.
[/olist]

notes.title: Time stop when you open the inventory!
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Now the game stops when the player opens the satchel. We implemented this because it was difficult for the players to play.
[*] Increased the area of attack with an axe in a sitting position. Previously, the player did not reach opponents in such cases as illustrations (when the player was sitting on the car)
[*] The sound of an axe swinging was when trying to attack in the air. This problem has also been fixed.
[*] The loot box was fixed in the third sewer.
[/olist]

notes.title: Gameplay from the developer
notes.content: Gameplay from the developer

notes.title: The recovery of energy(stamina) on the base!
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Now the player automatically recovers energy when he is on the base!
[*] A hint was added about restoring power to the base
[*] Now, if a player has been trained but has not been saved, they will not have to be trained again until they leave the game altogether.
[*] Fixed a bug with the "Chicken" food description.
[*] On the "Supermarket" location, the space for spawning a loot box has been fixed (it can be broken).
[*] Colliders have been fixed on the "Car dump" location, because of which large animals could not pass and got stuck!
[/olist]

notes.title: Gameplay from the developers
notes.content: Here I will now show how the developer plays this game

notes.title: Places to collect loot!
notes.content: In this update, loot collection locations have been improved. Now they are during the search - have an animated accompaniment. It looks better this way.

notes.title: Damage from the electricity!
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] All the mobs began to take damage from the electricity!
[*] Improved the hint where it is described how to sneak around a crowd of zombies.
[*] Changed the material at the destructible box so that players know that it can be broken!
[/olist]

notes.title: Fixed a problem with a quick restart of the game
notes.content:
[list]
[*] After the player's death, the player could quickly start the level again. But this could cause a number of problems, and also did not give the player at the beginning of the game (near the base) some items to start the game. 
[*] There was also a problem that a new player entering the game could click "Continue" the game, and this also did not work well enough!
[/list]
But now these problems have been fixed! I wish you all a good game! ːLike_Yellowː

notes.title: Added player training!
notes.content:
A little training for the player was added to the game:
1. How to use inventory to start playing.
2. How to sneak through a crowd of zombies.

Do not forget to throw out unnecessary items from your inventory! To do this, click on the item for a few seconds with the left mouse button.

notes.title: A new generation of the world. The new mobs. New location. New opportunity.
Bugfixes!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32200705/1b0f45aeb0f7216ee8304c76ada5a7eff12275a0.jpg[/img]
More than 50 defects/bugs were fixed in the game. The errors were related to the gameplay, animation, and a bit of the visual part. At the moment, it was decided to rewrite the code that is responsible for the generation of the world. This helps to optimize, as well as reduce the number of errors in the game, such as stuck mobs and loot in other objects.

notes.title: Sorry for the inconvenience!
New trailer! New changes in the game!
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xHBTXqN3TLI

Changes to the game:
- Fixed inventory issues.
- Implemented randomly generated "taxi", which allows the player to move once (instantly) to the base.
- Added 3 face masks that give certain bonuses to the player!
- Added 3 types of armor, in order to reduce the damage received from the zombie attacks!
- Implemented interface to visualize the remaining strength of the armor.
- Fixed a bug with the fire of the player.
- Added in the generation, where the player can "dig", and get a few useful items! (And can and not will find).
- Added a boat for which the player will look for spare parts to sail it to the rest of the survivors. If you find spare parts, then he doesn't have to be in the game for 30 days. It's an alternate ending, so to speak. Objects, logic and interface are implemented.
- Created a beautiful trailer showing the background of the game
- Added hints for the player in the survival book
- Added achievements to the survival book
- Implemented a system of remuneration for achievement.
- Added the ability to view information about the item in the inventory.
- Added" Non-walking " zombies that can't move. Are killed with one strike / shot being fired. And inflict damage if is near with them.

In addition, the game had a lot of other changes, which are now no longer remembered) The project is in active development) View additional trailer, which will show the background of the game: Like_Yellow:
